title: Qwen Prompt Gateway and vLLM integration
goal: Implement a FastAPI gateway for Qwen2-VL prompt refinement backed by a local vLLM OpenAI-compatible server.
acceptance_criteria: GET /health reports real gateway, vLLM, and model status.
GET /v1/model requires X-Internal-Token and returns configured model metadata.
POST /v1/prompts/refine validates multipart image and prompt input, calls vLLM, validates model JSON, and never returns fake success.
Model or vLLM unavailable states return standard failure JSON with appropriate HTTP status.
Deployment examples, requirements, verification scripts, and systemd units are included without committing secrets.
notes: Actual QWEN_API_TOKEN, VLLM_API_KEY, and .env must remain outside Git.
Successful refine testing requires a real backend job, user ID, user prompt, and uploaded image.
